send_mail.subject: Reminder: Northfield and Vireo letters due Dec 1, 5 pm ET
send_mail.body:
Dear Daniel,

A quick reminder that my Northfield Foundation Fellowship and Vireo Fellowship letters are due Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at 5:00 pm ET. The upload links:

Northfield: https://northfield-foundation.example.org/recommend/NF27-1187
Vireo: https://vireo-fellowship.example.org/letters/VF27-5531

Kestrel already confirmed your letter on Nov 20 - thank you!

Best,
Ana
